easy: How much light there is, so you can see things around you.

ex.en: The classroom had good illumination, so everyone could read.
ex.ko: 그 교실은 조명이 좋아서 모두가 책을 읽을 수 있었다.

easy: Having lost almost all your money.

ex.en: The impoverished family had no money for food.
ex.ko: 그 가난한 가족은 음식을 살 돈이 없었다.

easy: In a wrong way, not the way it should be done.

ex.en: He wore his helmet improperly, so it fell off.
ex.ko: 그는 헬멧을 제대로 쓰지 않아서 벗겨졌다.

easy: A quick, short punch straight ahead.

ex.en: The boxer threw a quick jab.
ex.ko: 권투 선수가 빠른 잽을 날렸다.

easy: A low piece of land that is filled up, often with trash and dirt.

ex.en: Trucks bring our trash to the landfill.
ex.ko: 트럭이 우리 쓰레기를 매립지로 가져간다.

easy: A person who works with an expert to learn a job.

ex.en: The young learner watched the carpenter work every day.
ex.ko: 그 견습생은 날마다 목수가 일하는 것을 지켜보았다.

easy: To make someone feel happier.

ex.en: Dad's funny joke lightened me up after my bad test.
ex.ko: 아빠의 웃긴 농담이 시험을 망친 내 기분을 풀어 주었다.

easy: To make something less heavy.

ex.en: I lightened my backpack by taking out two books.
ex.ko: 나는 책 두 권을 빼서 가방을 가볍게 했다.

easy: A dark red color with some brown in it.

ex.en: My school team wears maroon shirts.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 팀은 적갈색 셔츠를 입는다.

easy: Like a machine, without any feeling.

ex.en: He said sorry mechanically, without really meaning it.
ex.ko: 그는 진심 없이 기계적으로 미안하다고 말했다.

easy: To tie a boat to a dock so it stays in place.

ex.en: Dad moored the boat at the dock.
ex.ko: 아빠는 배를 부두에 묶어 두었다.

easy: To bring a ship to a dock and stop there.

ex.en: The ferry moored at the pier in the evening.
ex.ko: 여객선은 저녁에 부두에 정박했다.

easy: A small sweet bread baked in a cup shape.

ex.en: I ate a blueberry muffin for breakfast.
ex.ko: 나는 아침으로 블루베리 머핀을 먹었다.

easy: The top inside part of your mouth.

ex.en: The hot soup burned my palate.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 수프 때문에 입천장을 데었다.

easy: A flat, round cake made of thin batter and fried in a pan.

ex.en: Mom made pancakes with syrup on Sunday.
ex.ko: 엄마는 일요일에 시럽을 얹은 팬케이크를 만들어 주셨다.

easy: A wide road with trees growing along it.

ex.en: We drove down the parkway with tall trees on both sides.
ex.ko: 우리는 양쪽에 키 큰 나무가 늘어선 길을 달렸다.

easy: A record of an animal's parents and family.

ex.en: My dog has a pedigree showing its parents and grandparents.
ex.ko: 우리 강아지는 부모와 조부모가 적힌 혈통서가 있다.

easy: A very tiny spot.

ex.en: The plane looked like a pinpoint in the sky.
ex.ko: 비행기는 하늘에서 아주 작은 점처럼 보였다.

easy: In a happy and friendly way.

ex.en: Mom said pleasantly, "Good morning!"
ex.ko: 엄마는 상냥하게 "좋은 아침!" 하고 말했다.

easy: In a way that feels nice and fun.

ex.en: We spent a pleasantly lazy Sunday at home.
ex.ko: 우리는 일요일을 집에서 기분 좋게 느긋하게 보냈다.

easy: A toy that makes a noise when you shake it.

ex.en: The baby shook her rattle and laughed.
ex.ko: 아기는 딸랑이를 흔들며 웃었다.

easy: Money given back to you for money you already spent.

ex.en: Dad got a reimbursement for the train tickets he bought.
ex.ko: 아빠는 기차표를 사는 데 쓴 돈을 돌려받았다.

easy: To feel sorry for doing wrong and decide to change.

ex.en: He repented and said sorry to his sister.
ex.ko: 그는 뉘우치고 여동생에게 사과했다.

easy: Not awake and not able to feel or move.

ex.en: The boy lay senseless after he fell off his bike.
ex.ko: 그 소년은 자전거에서 떨어진 뒤 의식을 잃고 누워 있었다.

easy: Number 17 in a line; it comes right after number 16.

ex.en: I stood seventeenth in line for the water fountain.
ex.ko: 나는 물 마시는 곳 줄에서 열일곱 번째로 서 있었다.

easy: The place number 17 in a row or list.

ex.en: She finished seventeenth in the race.
ex.ko: 그녀는 달리기에서 열일곱 번째로 들어왔다.

easy: A way to go that is shorter than the usual way.

ex.en: We took a shortcut through the park to get to school.
ex.ko: 우리는 학교에 가려고 공원을 가로지르는 지름길로 갔다.

easy: Having to do with Sikhs, people who follow a religion from India.

ex.en: The Sikh temple has a big kitchen that feeds everyone.
ex.ko: 시크교 사원에는 모두에게 음식을 주는 큰 주방이 있다.

easy: A person who follows Sikhism, a religion from India.

ex.en: A Sikh family invited us to dinner.
ex.ko: 한 시크교도 가족이 우리를 저녁 식사에 초대했다.

easy: The moment a plane leaves the ground to fly.

ex.en: I held Mom's hand during the plane's takeoff.
ex.ko: 비행기가 이륙할 때 나는 엄마 손을 잡았다.

easy: The first part of a flight, when a plane lifts off the ground.

ex.en: The takeoff was loud, and my ears popped.
ex.ko: 이륙할 때 소리가 커서 내 귀가 먹먹해졌다.

easy: A machine with a moving belt that you walk or run on without going anywhere.

ex.en: Dad runs on the treadmill when it rains.
ex.ko: 아빠는 비가 오면 러닝머신 위에서 달린다.

easy: Not able to be stopped or avoided.

ex.en: Getting wet in the storm was unavoidable.
ex.ko: 폭풍우 속에서 젖는 것은 피할 수 없었다.

easy: Bent or twisted out of shape, like wood that got wet.

ex.en: The wet board was warped and would not lie flat.
ex.ko: 젖은 판자가 휘어서 평평하게 놓이지 않았다.

easy: A flying insect with a thin waist that can sting you.

ex.en: A wasp flew near my juice at the picnic.
ex.ko: 소풍에서 말벌 한 마리가 내 주스 근처로 날아왔다.

easy: A big round fruit with green skin, sweet red juicy inside, and black seeds.

ex.en: We ate cold watermelon on the hot summer day.
ex.ko: 우리는 더운 여름날 시원한 수박을 먹었다.

easy: Going toward the west.

ex.en: The geese took a westward path across the sky.
ex.ko: 기러기들은 하늘을 가로질러 서쪽으로 날아갔다.

easy: Having a sour kind of stuff called acid in it.

ex.en: Lemon juice is acidic, so it tastes sour.
ex.ko: 레몬즙은 산성이라서 신맛이 난다.

easy: The way things stick together, like glue on paper.

ex.en: The glue has strong adherence, so the paper will not come off.
ex.ko: 이 풀은 접착력이 강해서 종이가 떨어지지 않는다.

easy: When you lose your memory and cannot remember things.

ex.en: After hitting his head, the man had amnesia and forgot his name.
ex.ko: 머리를 부딪힌 뒤 그 남자는 기억상실증에 걸려 자기 이름을 잊었다.

easy: In a way that shows you are mad.

ex.en: She angrily slammed her book shut.
ex.ko: 그녀는 화가 나서 책을 쾅 덮었다.

easy: Showing that you like or agree with something.

ex.en: Dad gave me an approving nod.
ex.ko: 아빠는 인정한다는 듯 고개를 끄덕이셨다.

easy: A medicine that people take to stop pain or lower a fever.

ex.en: Mom took an aspirin for her headache.
ex.ko: 엄마는 두통 때문에 아스피린을 드셨다.

easy: A person who writes poems and, long ago, sang them.

ex.en: The bard sang a song about a brave knight.
ex.ko: 음유시인은 용감한 기사에 대한 노래를 불렀다.

easy: Having hair on the cheeks and chin.

ex.en: My bearded uncle looks like Santa.
ex.ko: 수염이 난 우리 삼촌은 산타 할아버지처럼 보인다.

easy: Kind and wanting to help other people.

ex.en: The benevolent old man gave food to hungry cats.
ex.ko: 인자한 할아버지가 배고픈 고양이들에게 먹이를 주셨다.

easy: A book that many people buy very fast.

ex.en: My favorite story book is a bestseller.
ex.ko: 내가 제일 좋아하는 동화책은 베스트셀러다.

easy: A line that shows where one place ends and another begins.

ex.en: The borderline between the two yards is a small fence.
ex.ko: 두 마당의 경계선은 작은 울타리다.

easy: A small house with only one floor.

ex.en: Grandma lives in a small bungalow near the beach.
ex.ko: 할머니는 바닷가 근처 작은 단층집에 사신다.

easy: A person who breaks into a house to steal things.

ex.en: The burglar ran away when our dog barked.
ex.ko: 우리 개가 짖자 도둑이 도망갔다.

easy: To use a chance or a situation to get something good.

ex.en: Our team capitalized on the other team's mistake and scored.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 상대 팀의 실수를 이용해 점수를 냈다.

easy: A special charm that makes people like you and listen to you.

ex.en: Our class president has charisma, so everyone listens to her.
ex.ko: 우리 반 회장은 카리스마가 있어서 모두가 그녀의 말을 듣는다.

easy: A kid who is in your class at school.

ex.en: My classmate shared her crayons with me.
ex.ko: 반 친구가 나에게 크레용을 나눠 주었다.

easy: A pot or machine used for cooking.

ex.en: Mom cooks rice in the cooker every night.
ex.ko: 엄마는 매일 저녁 밥솥으로 밥을 지으신다.

easy: A car with two doors.

ex.en: Dad's red coupe has only two doors.
ex.ko: 아빠의 빨간 쿠페는 문이 두 개뿐이다.

easy: Wanted very much by many people.

ex.en: She won the coveted gold medal.
ex.ko: 그녀는 모두가 탐내는 금메달을 땄다.

easy: Shaped like a tube or a can.

ex.en: A soup can is cylindrical.
ex.ko: 수프 통조림은 원통형이다.

easy: Making you believe something that is not true.

ex.en: The calm water looked safe, but it was deceptive and very deep.
ex.ko: 잔잔한 물은 안전해 보였지만 겉모습과 달리 아주 깊었다.

easy: To think or believe that something is a certain way.

ex.en: The teacher deemed my drawing the best in class.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내 그림을 반에서 최고라고 여기셨다.

easy: When something is totally broken, wrecked, or empty.

ex.en: After the storm, the devastation of our town was sad to see.
ex.ko: 폭풍 뒤 우리 마을의 황폐한 모습은 보기 슬펐다.

easy: A feeling of being so sad and shocked that you cannot think.

ex.en: Devastation filled her when her pet fish died.
ex.ko: 키우던 물고기가 죽자 그녀는 망연자실했다.

easy: Very religious and faithful.

ex.en: My grandma is devout and goes to church every Sunday.
ex.ko: 우리 할머니는 독실해서 일요일마다 교회에 가신다.

easy: Too big or too small when compared to something else.

ex.en: The cartoon dog had a disproportionate, huge head.
ex.ko: 그 만화 속 강아지는 머리가 몸에 비해 너무 컸다.

easy: Not the right size when compared to something else.

ex.en: His giant feet looked disproportionate to his small body.
ex.ko: 그의 큰 발은 작은 몸에 비해 균형이 맞지 않아 보였다.

easy: A very dark black color.

ex.en: The cat's fur was ebony, black as night.
ex.ko: 고양이 털은 밤처럼 새까만 칠흑색이었다.

easy: Hard, very dark wood used for piano keys.

ex.en: The black keys on the piano are made of ebony.
ex.ko: 피아노의 검은 건반은 흑단으로 만든다.

easy: Changing suddenly in ways you cannot guess.

ex.en: The weather was erratic, sunny one minute and stormy the next.
ex.ko: 날씨가 변덕스러워서 해가 났다가 갑자기 폭풍이 쳤다.

easy: Not following a set path.

ex.en: The bee's erratic flight zigzagged over the garden.
ex.ko: 벌의 불규칙한 비행은 정원 위를 지그재그로 날았다.

easy: A big party, often held outside.

ex.en: We danced at the fiesta in the park.
ex.ko: 우리는 공원 잔치에서 춤을 췄다.

easy: Doing something silly without thinking.

ex.en: Riding a bike with no brakes down a hill is folly.
ex.ko: 브레이크 없이 자전거로 언덕을 내려가는 것은 어리석은 짓이다.

easy: Able to be guessed before it happens.

ex.en: It was foreseeable that the ice cream would melt in the hot sun.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 햇볕에 아이스크림이 녹을 것은 충분히 예상할 수 있었다.

easy: A man from France.

ex.en: A Frenchman showed us how to bake bread.
ex.ko: 한 프랑스 남자가 빵 굽는 법을 보여 주었다.

easy: Smoky, bad-smelling gas that comes out of an engine.

ex.en: The bus fumes made me cough.
ex.ko: 버스 배기가스 때문에 기침이 났다.

easy: Looking blank and not shining, like someone very tired or bored.

ex.en: His eyes were glazed after the long car ride.
ex.ko: 긴 차 여행 뒤에 그의 눈은 멍했다.

easy: Having glass put in it.

ex.en: The glazed porch let us watch the snow fall.
ex.ko: 유리를 끼운 베란다에서 눈 내리는 모습을 볼 수 있었다.

easy: Strong wood from trees like oak and maple.

ex.en: Our living room floor is made of hardwood.
ex.ko: 우리 집 거실 바닥은 활엽수 목재로 되어 있다.

easy: Understanding something only after it has already happened.

ex.en: In hindsight, I should have worn a coat.
ex.ko: 돌이켜 보니 코트를 입었어야 했다.

easy: Not caring and showing no feelings.

ex.en: He answered with indifference and kept playing his game.
ex.ko: 그는 무관심하게 대답하고 계속 게임을 했다.

easy: Something you must have because you cannot do without it.

ex.en: A map is indispensable on a long hike.
ex.ko: 오래 걷는 하이킹에서는 지도가 꼭 필요하다.

easy: Absolutely needed.

ex.en: Water is indispensable for plants.
ex.ko: 식물에게 물은 없어서는 안 된다.

easy: To hold someone back from doing something.

ex.en: Shyness can inhibit a kid from raising a hand.
ex.ko: 수줍음 때문에 아이가 손을 들지 못할 수도 있다.

easy: To slow something down or stop it from working well.

ex.en: Cold weather can inhibit plant growth.
ex.ko: 추운 날씨는 식물의 성장을 억제할 수 있다.

easy: In a wild, crazy way.

ex.en: The puppy ran insanely around the yard.
ex.ko: 강아지가 마당을 미친 듯이 뛰어다녔다.

easy: Very, very much.

ex.en: The roller coaster was insanely fast.
ex.ko: 롤러코스터는 엄청나게 빨랐다.

easy: In a way that uses your mind and thinking.

ex.en: The chess game was intellectually hard but fun.
ex.ko: 체스는 머리를 많이 써야 해서 어렵지만 재미있었다.

easy: Between the stars.

ex.en: Interstellar space is very cold and dark.
ex.ko: 별과 별 사이의 우주는 매우 춥고 어둡다.

easy: Happening without you choosing it.

ex.en: A sneeze is an involuntary action.
ex.ko: 재채기는 내가 선택하지 않아도 나오는 행동이다.

easy: Working on its own, without you thinking about it.

ex.en: Your heart beats in an involuntary way, even when you sleep.
ex.ko: 심장은 자는 동안에도 나도 모르게 저절로 뛴다.

easy: Making your skin feel like you must scratch it.

ex.en: My mosquito bite is so itchy.
ex.ko: 모기 물린 데가 너무 가렵다.

easy: A small bar or catch that keeps a door or gate closed.

ex.en: I lifted the latch and opened the garden gate.
ex.ko: 나는 걸쇠를 올려 마당 문을 열었다.

easy: A strong band inside your body that holds bones together.

ex.en: He hurt a ligament in his knee playing soccer.
ex.ko: 그는 축구를 하다가 무릎 인대를 다쳤다.

easy: Looking or being alike.

ex.en: There is a strong likeness between me and my brother.
ex.ko: 나와 내 동생은 서로 많이 닮았다.

easy: A picture of a person or thing.

ex.en: The artist drew a likeness of our dog.
ex.ko: 화가가 우리 강아지를 닮게 그려 주었다.

easy: Wanting to hurt someone on purpose.

ex.en: There was no malice in his joke; he just wanted to make us laugh.
ex.ko: 그의 농담에는 악의가 없었고 우리를 웃기고 싶었을 뿐이다.

easy: Making you want to do something.

ex.en: The coach gave a motivating talk before the game.
ex.ko: 코치는 경기 전에 힘이 나는 말을 해 주었다.

easy: Thinking and acting in your own way.

ex.en: Her story showed great originality.
ex.ko: 그녀의 이야기는 매우 독창적이었다.

easy: Being new and different, not copied.

ex.en: I love the originality of your costume.
ex.ko: 네 의상이 정말 독창적이라서 좋아.

easy: A plant grown to look pretty.

ex.en: The garden had many ornamentals, like roses and tulips.
ex.ko: 그 정원에는 장미와 튤립 같은 관상용 식물이 많았다.

easy: A room in a house where people sit, talk, and relax.

ex.en: Grandpa read the newspaper in the parlor.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 응접실에서 신문을 읽으셨다.

easy: Not giving up, even when something is hard.

ex.en: With perseverance, I learned to ride my bike.
ex.ko: 끈기를 갖고 노력해서 나는 자전거 타기를 배웠다.

easy: Caring too much about small details and hard to please.

ex.en: My little brother is a picky eater.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 먹는 것이 까다롭다.

easy: The people who live in a place, all together.

ex.en: The whole populace of the town came to the parade.
ex.ko: 마을 사람들 모두가 퍼레이드에 왔다.

easy: Making more plants or animals by seeds or babies.

ex.en: Bees help the propagation of flowers.
ex.ko: 벌은 꽃이 번식하는 것을 돕는다.

easy: A metal heater with hot water or steam pipes that warms a room.

ex.en: I put my wet gloves on the radiator to dry.
ex.ko: 나는 젖은 장갑을 라디에이터 위에 올려 말렸다.

easy: Making fun of someone in a mean way.

ex.en: No one should face ridicule for the way they talk.
ex.ko: 누구도 말하는 방식 때문에 조롱당해서는 안 된다.

easy: Laughing at someone in a mean way.

ex.en: He felt hurt by the ridicule of the other kids.
ex.ko: 그는 다른 아이들의 비웃음에 상처받았다.

easy: Cooking meat in an oven.

ex.en: The slow roasting of the turkey took all morning.
ex.ko: 칠면조를 천천히 굽는 데 아침 내내 걸렸다.

easy: A person who plays or loves rock music.

ex.en: My uncle is a rocker who plays guitar in a band.
ex.ko: 우리 삼촌은 밴드에서 기타를 치는 록 음악가다.

easy: An artist who makes statues.

ex.en: The sculptor carved a horse from a block of stone.
ex.ko: 조각가는 돌덩이로 말 한 마리를 깎았다.

easy: A soft shine on a surface.

ex.en: The horse's coat had a lovely sheen.
ex.ko: 그 말의 털은 윤기가 흘렀다.

easy: Being honest and meaning what you say.

ex.en: I could hear the sincerity in her apology.
ex.ko: 그녀의 사과에서 진심이 느껴졌다.

easy: Saying false things that hurt someone's good name.

ex.en: Telling lies about a classmate is slander.
ex.ko: 반 친구에 대해 거짓말을 퍼뜨리는 것은 비방이다.
